sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Kumar Pandey,Ramanuj Saini Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Akhilesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B.Maurya, learned AGA-I, for the State.

The instant application has been moved on behalf of the applicant to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 257 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 IPC, Police Station Jahanabad,
District Pilibhit during pendency of the trial.

According to the FIR, applicant along with co-accused Siyaram promised the informant to provide him a government job and both the accused received Rs. One Lac Twenty Thousand from the informant and it is further alleged that informant also received a fake and forged appointment letter through registered post.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and even as per allegation, inducement with regard to provide a government job to the informant was made by co-accused Siyaram and applicant has been made accused in the present case on the basis of general allegation.

He further submits that the alleged fraud is said to have been committed in the year 2019 but FIR of the present case was lodged in the year 2022, i.e.,

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant placed copy of the bail order of co-accused Siyaram during the course of argument which is taken on record.

He next submits that although applicant is having criminal history of four other cases but he has explained criminal history of applicant in paragraph-2 to the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.
He next submits that applicant is in jail in the present matter since 27.10.2022.
Per contra, learned AGA although opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

As per FIR, in the year 2019 applicant and co-accused Siyaram received Rs. One Lac Twenty Thousand from the informant under the guise to provide him a government job and thereafter informant also received a fake appointment letter through registered post but the FIR of the present case was lodged in the year 2022, i.e, after about three years and it appears that applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with co-accused Siyaram on the basis of general allegation and the allegation of inducement is against co-accused Siyaram and co-accused Siyaram
has already been released on bail by this Court on 11.1.2023 passed in Criminal Misc.Bail Application No.59074 of 2022.

Although applicant is having criminal history of four other cases but his criminal history has been explained in paragraph-2 to the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the present bail application and applicant is in jail in the present matter since October, 2022, therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Omkar be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
